label: Kotlin
description: Our primary backend language. Mature ecosystem, excellent Java interop, and strong team expertise.

label: Scala
description: Too complex for enterprise. Lack of up to date tooling.

label: Spring Boot
description: Standard framework for building backend services. Well-understood by the team.

label: TypeScript
description: Default language for all frontend and Node.js work. Type safety prevents entire classes of bugs.

label: Next.js
description: Evaluating for our web applications. Server components and app router show promise.

label: React
description: Our standard frontend library. Large ecosystem and strong community.

label: Flutter
description: Cross-platform mobile development. Evaluating for our mobile applications.

label: Rust
description: Exploring for performance-critical services. Memory safety without garbage collection.

label: PostgreSQL
description: Our default relational database. Reliable, feature-rich, and well-supported.

label: Supabase
description: Backend-as-a-service built on PostgreSQL. Evaluating for rapid prototyping and smaller projects.

label: AWS
description: Primary cloud provider. Well-established infrastructure and team knowledge.

label: Kubernetes
description: Container orchestration standard. Running all production workloads.

label: GitHub Actions
description: Our CI/CD platform. Integrated with our GitHub workflow.

label: Kafka
description: Event streaming platform. Evaluating for event-driven architectures.

label: Docker
description: Standard containerization tool across all projects.

label: Datadog
description: Evaluating as our unified observability platform.

label: Sentry
description: Error tracking and performance monitoring across all applications.

label: Terraform
description: Infrastructure as code. All cloud resources managed through Terraform.

label: Claude Code
description: AI-powered coding assistant. Evaluating for developer productivity.

label: SonarQube
description: Static code analysis. Exploring for code quality enforcement in CI.

label: Trunk-Based Development
description: Short-lived feature branches merged frequently. Reduces integration pain.

label: Event Sourcing
description: Exploring for audit-heavy domains. Powerful but adds complexity.

label: Micro Frontends
description: Too much operational overhead for our team size. Monolithic frontend preferred for now.

label: API-First Design
description: Design APIs before implementation using OpenAPI specs. Enables parallel frontend/backend work.

label: Architecture Decision Records
description: Lightweight documentation of significant technical decisions. Building the habit across teams.

label: Platform Engineering
description: Internal developer platform to reduce cognitive load. Exploring what this means for our scale.
